label: Battery
description: Charge, health and power source. Desktops report no battery.

label: CPU
description: Processor model, cores, threads and clock.

label: Displays
description: Screens with their resolution and position, and the monitors behind them.

label: USB devices
description: USB devices that are plugged in.

label: Disk health
description: Whether each disk reports a problem. Temperature, wear and error counts need administrator rights.
